name: tab_depth
expr: min(tab_full_depth, row_depth / 2, divider_top - tab_front_height - floor_height - 1 mm)

name: rows_limit
expr: min(12, floor((2 * inner_half_depth + divider_thickness) / (row_min_depth + divider_thickness)), floor(compartments_limit / compartments_across))

name: lip_opening_area
expr: (2 * half_width - 2 * lip_slope) * (2 * half_depth - 2 * lip_slope) - (4 - pi) * (bin_corner_radius - lip_slope) ^ 2

name: foot_side_area
expr: (foot_perimeter_low + foot_perimeter_mid) / 2 * sqrt(2) * foot_chamfer_low + foot_perimeter_mid * foot_straight + (foot_perimeter_mid + foot_perimeter_top) / 2 * sqrt(2) * foot_chamfer_high

step: if(corners_only, width_units * grid_pitch - 2 * hole_inset, grid_pitch - 2 * hole_inset)
name: Holes across

step: if(corners_only, depth_units * grid_pitch - 2 * hole_inset, grid_pitch - 2 * hole_inset)
name: Holes of a unit
overall_height
label: Height with the lip, foot to rim

name: inside_height
label: Inside depth, floor to the top of the dividers

name: label_flat_depth
label: Flat label area, front to back, in the back row (0 = none)

Feet: one bottom face per unit
Feet: side area of the 0.8, 1.8 and 2.15 mm profile in every unit
Floor: solid at 6.5 mm, no pocket or hole breaks through
Lip: the straight band of the stacking lip has the published depth
Seats in a baseplate: no part of the bin enters the cell at the far corners
Seats in a baseplate: the foot's lower 45 degree face touches the socket's
Seats in a baseplate: the foot's upper 45 degree face touches the socket's

Stacks: the foot of a stacked bin rests on the lip

FDM: dividers between rows are at least 1.2 mm thick
Walls: the side walls are the wall thickness
Walls: the front wall is the wall thickness
FDM: no flat face overhangs more than 45 degrees from the bed
FDM: the rounded corners of the feet and the lip are no steeper than 45 degrees
FDM: the bed-side overhangs are only the hole ceilings and the bridges between feet
Scoops: one quarter round per compartment
Label tabs: a front face in every compartment
Label tabs: the flat area in the back row reaches to the lip or rim above it
min: max(4.5 mm + tab_nose_radius, tab_depth - tab_back_overhang - 0.001 mm)

width_units
label: Width
description: Width of the bin in Gridfinity units of 42 mm

name: depth_units
label: Depth
description: Depth of the bin in Gridfinity units of 42 mm

name: height_units
label: Height
description: Height in Gridfinity units of 7 mm, base included, without the stacking lip (6 units is 42 mm). A label tab needs at least 3 units.

name: compartments_across
label: Compartments side by side
description: How many compartments next to each other, across the width. Each is at least 12 mm wide.

name: compartment_rows
label: Rows of compartments
description: How many rows front to back. Each row is at least 14 mm deep, and the bin holds at most 48 compartments in all.

name: label_tab
label: Label tab
description: A sloping tab at the back of every compartment, for a label and to grip the bin: across the compartment, or a 42 mm strip in its middle. Prints without supports.

name: scoop
label: Scoop
description: A rounded front inside every compartment, so small parts slide out

name: base_holes
label: Holes in the base
description: Holes for 6 x 2 mm magnets or M3 screws in the corners of the units, or magnets only at the four corners of the bin to save magnets

name: stacking_lip
label: Stacking lip
description: The Gridfinity lip on top that the next bin stands in. Without it the wall ends in a plain rounded rim.

name: wall_thickness
label: Wall thickness
description: Thickness of the outer walls: three 0.4 mm perimeters is 1.2 mm. With the stacking lip the wall stays inside the lip's 1.9 mm step, at most 1.8 mm.

name: show_fit_gauges
label: Show fit gauges
description: Adds two gauges, a baseplate socket and the foot of a stacked bin, at the far corners of the bin, and proves the fit against them. For checking only: leave it off before you export, so the file holds just the bin.

title: Gridfinity bin
description: A storage bin for the open Gridfinity system (credit Zack Freedman, MIT): choose its size in 42 mm grid units and 7 mm height units, how many compartments and rows it has, label tabs and scoops, holes for magnets or screws, and the stacking lip. The base and lip follow the published Gridfinity profiles, and with Show fit gauges on, the bin proves that it seats in a baseplate and stacks. It prints standing on its feet, without supports. To export it for your slicer, use File > Export..., format 3MF or STL: with Show fit gauges off, as it is by default, the file holds just the bin.
author: 3DCraft Jigs
